title: mountflutes
description: A Minecraft mod that adds flutes to summon/unsummon your mounts, akin to Stardew Valley
body:
# Mount Flutes
Adds flutes that can be linked to your mounts. Lets you summon or unsummon them. 

Currently adds a flute for:
- Horses
- Donkeys
- Mules

Currently, if your mount is not in loaded chunks, you will not be able to unsummon or summon them.
